task: Should a small company run its own servers or move everything to the cloud? Give a recommendation for a team of ten people.

nodes.name: Fact checker
nodes.instructions: Check the draft from the previous agent. Fix wrong or unsupported claims and add anything important that is missing, especially staff time, migration work and ongoing fees. Return the whole corrected draft, not a list of comments.

nodes.name: Editor
nodes.instructions: Edit the text from the previous agent for a busy manager. Keep it under 200 words, use plain language, and end with one sentence that gives the recommendation.
